statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-53057 is an Oracle Java SE Security (java.security) issue from the October 2025 Critical Patch Update, fixed in OpenJDK 21.0.9 by JDK-8360937 ("Enhance certificate handling"). The fix changes how X.509 distinguished names are parsed and rendered (sun.security.util.DerValue and sun.security.x509.AVA): before 21.0.9, BMPString values containing surrogate characters were accepted, and the RFC 2253 string forms decoded PrintableString, IA5String, T61String and BMPString values as UTF-8 regardless of their encoding. The Java version was read from each published image with java -version: 5.0.0 and 5.0.1 ship Temurin 21.0.8+9, 5.0.2 and 5.0.3 ship 21.0.9+10, and later images ship 21.0.10 or newer. Liquibase Secure validates server certificates on TLS connections (bundled JDBC drivers, HTTPS to license and cloud service endpoints), and certificate parsing decodes these names, so the changed code is likely reached; the path through the default PKIX trust manager has not been traced end to end. Oracle has not published how the flaw leads to the integrity impact it reports, no public exploit is known, and Oracle rates the issue difficult to exploit.

Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: JAXP). Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u461, 8u461-perf, 11.0.28, 17.0.16, 21.0.8, 25; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.16 and 21.0.8; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.15.

statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java SE Libraries (core-libs) issue, fixed in OpenJDK 21.0.9 by JDK-8359454 ("Enhance String handling"). The Java version was read from each published image with java -version: 5.0.0 and 5.0.1 ship Temurin 21.0.8+9, 5.0.2 and later ship 21.0.9 or newer. The fix changes a single branch of java.lang.AbstractStringBuilder.insert(int, CharSequence, int, int): the one taken when the inserted sequence is a String and only part of it is inserted. A whole String now goes through the existing putStringAt(int, String) path, which copies the same bytes as the code it replaced, so the behaviour that changed is limited to inserting a sub-range of a String. A bytecode scan of the 5.0.0 and 5.0.1 images found no caller of that form. In the JRE's lib/modules, no class other than StringBuilder, StringBuffer and AbstractStringBuilder references the four-argument insert. Across all jars under /liquibase, including nested jars and the license-tracking application, its only caller is the shaded ICU class CollationIterator$SkippedState in liquibase-checks.jar, which inserts a StringBuilder, not a String. The callers of insert(int, CharSequence), which forwards the whole sequence, are in shaded ICU and the DB2 JDBC driver and insert either a StringBuilder or a whole sequence. The changed code is therefore not executed by Liquibase Secure.

statements.status_notes: An integer overflow in the tt_var_load_item_variation_store function of the Freetype library in versions 2.13.2 and 2.13.3 may allow for an out of bounds read operation when parsing HVAR/VVAR/MVAR tables in OpenType variable fonts. This issue is fixed in version 2.14.2.
statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java SE 2D (FreeType) issue from the April 2026 Critical Patch Update, fixed in OpenJDK 21.0.11. The flaw is an integer overflow in FreeType's tt_var_load_item_variation_store, reached only while FreeType parses the HVAR, VVAR or MVAR table of an OpenType variable font. The JDK ships its own FreeType (lib/libfreetype.so), which it uses to rasterise text: 2.13.3, in range, in the 21.0.8 to 21.0.10 JREs of Docker images 5.0.0 through 5.1.1, and the fixed 2.14.2 or later from 5.2.0. Exploitation needs the JVM to open an attacker-supplied variable font. The JDK opens either a font file passed to Font.createFont or a font that fontconfig lists from the system font directories, owned by root, or from per-user font directories that only the account running Liquibase can write. No class in the jars shipped in the 5.0.0 through 5.1.1 images calls Font.createFont. The image's only installed fonts are the DejaVu TrueType fonts under /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu, which are static fonts with no fvar, HVAR, VVAR or MVAR table. The container entrypoint runs only the Liquibase CLI and the optional lpm helper, a statically linked Go binary.

statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java 2D partial-denial-of-service issue. statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java SE Security (java.security) issue, fixed in OpenJDK 21.0.12. The JRE was read from the release file of each published Liquibase Secure image: 5.0.0 and 5.0.1 ship Temurin 21.0.8, 5.0.2 and 5.0.3 ship 21.0.9, 5.1.0 and 5.1.1 ship 21.0.10, 5.2.0 and 5.2.1 ship 21.0.11, 5.2.2 ships 21.0.12+8 and 6.0.0 ships 21.0.12.1+1, so 5.2.2 and later already carry the fix. Liquibase Secure is neither. It runs as a command-line client that starts no listener, runs no untrusted code, and only connects outbound to the database and service endpoints its operator configures.

statements.impact_statement: JDK Security component (resource resolving) vulnerability, part of Oracle's August 2026 CPU. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse- temurin:21-jre-noble (docker/Dockerfile:2) and never listens on a socket; it is only an outbound network client (HTTPS to license/hub endpoints, TLS JDBC to target databases). statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java SE/GraalVM Install-component vulnerability, fixed upstream in 21.0.12 (Oracle August 2026 CPU). The flaw is in Oracle's Java installer, a packaging component that ships only with Oracle's own distribution. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble (core/docker/Dockerfile:1) via docker-entrypoint.sh (core/docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:8); Temurin's JRE is unpacked from a release archive, not installed through Oracle's installer, so the vulnerable component is not present in the image at all. There is no Adoptium/Temurin tracking entry for this CVE. Unlike the other Oracle Java SE entries in this batch (sandbox/Web Start applicability mismatches, justified requires_environment), this is a component absence -- the installer isn't shipped at all -- hence code_not_present.
